# FG-DB-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`append-only-violation`](../../ops/runbooks/append-only-violation.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_update_of_an_append_only_table_is_append_only_violation` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: データの保護の仕組みが働きました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: A data protection safeguard was triggered. Contact the administrator.
- id: Pengaman perlindungan data terpicu. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

An append-only safeguard of the database (ADR-0018) failed: a guard trigger rejected an UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE of an append-only table (SQLSTATE XF001 — a bug or a manual change), forge doctor found a guard missing or weakened (a role attribute, a login holding an extra role, the owner of schema forge_audit or a log table, a guard trigger or event trigger missing, extra, re-pointed or not enabled ALWAYS, a guard function's owner, body or privileges, the bootstrap version), or a membership of a forge role is not one of the fixed ones or of database.privileged_members (or carries ADMIN OPTION).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event carries `reason`: rejected (with `query`, `sqlstate=XF001` and `db_message` naming the operation and table), guard_missing (with `guard`: bootstrap_version (`found` / `expected`), role_attributes (`role`), role_separation (`role`, `member_of`), object_owner (`object`), log_triggers / event_triggers (`trigger`), function_owner / function_body / function_privilege (`function`, `role`)), role_membership_changed (with `unexpected` / `missing` as member->role; role names are in the log only, not in forge doctor output). Run `forge doctor --json` (read-only) and compare the db.bootstrap check with ops/db/bootstrap/; read forge_audit.ddl_audit for the time of the change.

## 対処 (fix)

rejected: find the caller named by `query` — append-only tables are changed only by their owning functions. guard_missing: re-run 03-database-objects.sql (an approved runbook step; it recreates every guard trigger, event trigger, function and privilege) or 01-cluster-roles.sql for role attributes. role_membership_changed: revoke the unexpected membership, or add role:member to database.privileged_members after review.
